bounds_measurement_limit: mesh_bounds_bottom_cm is component axis-aligned bounds origin minus Z extent. It is a coarse estimate, not the exact posed mesh foot sole or visual ground-contact measurement. Capsule floor clearance is allowed up to 3 cm.
timing_measurement_limit: frame_ms is component simulation DeltaTime; wall_frame_ms is elapsed wall time between component ticks. This scripted editor/game run is not a stable performance baseline; camera motion, screenshots, warm-up, caps and editor overhead affect timing.
animation_evidence_limit: State, native proxy evaluation count and actual component-space bone rotation traces prove sampled Idle/Walk/Jump poses. Screenshots and manual review are still required for likeness, transitions, normals, shadows and perceptual pose quality.
input_evidence_limit: Movement, Jump, Pause and Reset use simulated PlayerController InputKey events through the saved keyboard Enhanced Input mappings. Fixture placement uses teleport/ResetToSpawn. These tests prove the mapping-to-callback-to-gameplay pipeline, not physical hardware, OS focus, controller hardware or pause UI.
performance_limit: Preliminary 1080p editor-game baseline only. Each mesh-visible/mesh-hidden-and-animation-tick-disabled group discards 2 s warmup then samples 5 s wall frame/Game/Render/GPU time. Screenshots and CPU skin extraction are outside these intervals. Background applications, shader compilation, VSync, frame caps, quality and driver affect values. GPU zero is unavailable, not zero cost.
continuous_recording_limit: Optional frame sequence requests screenshots no faster than 8 fps in wall time; requested frames may be dropped/overwritten by case screenshots. Recording frame timestamps and file existence are recorded. A fixed-fps video made from these frames is a review aid, not a timing measurement.

actual_cpu_skinned_surface.method: USkinnedMeshComponent::GetCPUSkinnedVertices LOD0, each posed vertex transformed into world coordinates, minimum world Z across all mesh sections
actual_cpu_skinned_surface.limit: This is the lowest actual posed mesh vertex, not component bounds or a foot-bone position. A visual check must confirm the lowest region belongs to the feet and judge contact/shadows. CPU skin extraction stalls rendering and is excluded from performance samples.
